definitions.full: H5965. alas [ עָלַס ] verb rejoice (|| with עָלַץ עָלַז, , q. v.; Late Hebrew עֲלִיסָה rejoicing (once Levy NHWB iii. 657 )); — Qal Imperfect 3masculine singular יַעֲלֹס Job 20:18 he shall not rejoice . Niph`al Perfect 3feminine singular נֶעֱלָ֑סָה Job 39:13 (of ostrich's wing) = flap joyously . Hithpa`el Imperfect 1plural cohortative נִתְעַלְּסָה Prov 7:18 let us delight ourselves in ( ב ) love.
